name: star-rsm-invoice-reconciliation
description: Reconcile STAR session-log CSVs and RSM invoice exports at the session level.

interface.longDescription: Compare STAR session logs with RSM invoice exports and surface duplicate slots, missing sessions, count mismatches, and amount discrepancies.
defaultPrompt: Use the STAR–RSM Invoice Reconciliation plugin to compare my STAR session log and RSM invoice export.
